name: ag-studio-website
description: Avantgarde Studio website: site/ is the static site; _工具/ and tools/ rebuild and check it; server/ deploys it.

scripts.build: node _工具/build-pages.js site && node _工具/prerender.js site
scripts.deploy:worker: cd workers/lab-results && npx -y wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply ag-lab --remote && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy site --project-name avantgarde-site --branch main
